newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S inflation gauge 106.1 Sept 13 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S inflation gauge 106.1 Sept 13 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) fell to 106.1 in the week ended September 13 from a revised 106.4 the previous week, ECRI said.
Slower growth in industrial materials prices and a rise in the insured unemployment rate contributed to the decline in the inflation gauge, according to ECRI.
"Inflationary pressures are still relatively subdued," ECRI said. "The gauge continues to look forward to fairly benign inflation in the months ahead."
